fixed_boundary_data.target: full oriented radial response with rho, endpoint e, and Wronskian w coordinates

balanced_kernel.meaning: internal endpoint-Wronskian redistribution invisible to both retained radial projection and canonical codiagonal

explicit_nonuniqueness.construction: for any continuous shell-natural reciprocal-equivariant map ell:P_pair->W_bal, define D_ell(x)=(0,ell_+(x)/2,ell_+(x);ell_-(x)/2,ell_-(x))
properties: all jets and shell bonding preserved when ell preserves them
explicit_nonuniqueness.conclusion: neighboring face equations alone do not make the filler space contractible or singleton

conditional_rigidity.extra_hypothesis: every admissible filler factors through the same source-generated full-response map U, equivalently ran(D) subset ran(U)
conditional_rigidity.recovery_property: ran(U) intersect N_bal={0}, obtained when ker(P_rho U)=ker(U)=Z_1(G)
conditional_rigidity.proof: ran(D) subset N_bal from fixed faces and ran(D) subset ran(U) from common factorization, hence ran(D)={0}

minimal_missing_rigidity_datum.name: source_range_saturation
minimal_missing_rigidity_datum.statement: the legacy filler U_G4 and canonical T_PB land in the same source-generated full-response range, or their difference does
minimal_missing_rigidity_datum.equivalent_square: there exists a common source map U_full and fixed response projections through which both fillers factor

effect_on_legacy_gate: To infer U_G4=T_PB from neighboring tetrahedra, it suffices to prove source-range saturation. This is weaker and more geometric than comparing every port coefficient, but it remains an independent old-G4 range theorem.
disposition: Rigidity does not fall out from the boundary faces alone because the balanced endpoint-Wronskian kernel supports an affine family of fillers. It does fall out immediately after one exact saturation statement: both fillers must live in the recovered source-generated full-response range, whose intersection with that kernel is zero.
